Species/stats/types/abilities/items/sprites/moves all read live, with speciesRevisedProfile and moveData (gBattleMoves_Revised) overriding the base tables where Rogue rebalances a species or move. _expansionNote: This ROM is a pokeemerald-expansion build. Party structs use standard Gen 3 encryption (XOR with personality^otId, substructures permuted by personality % 24) rather than the plaintext layout CFRU hacks like Unbound use. GBAPal's Gen3Decrypt handles both and picks per slot by validating the checksum, so no setting is needed -- partyFormat here is informational. Still unsupported in the app: sprites, because expansion keeps its sprite pointers inside gSpeciesInfo instead of the 8-byte pointer table the app reads, which is why no frontSpriteTable/paletteTable key is emitted for this profile. The extracted asset JSONs are correct.

moveNames.note: gMoveNames. Bundled JSON is vanilla move data and does not know Rogue's added/renumbered moves at all, which is why moves like Work Up and Aqua Jet were showing up as unrelated vanilla move names before this table was found.

moveData.note: gBattleMoves_Revised -- Rogue's 'Revision Mode' move table, used whenever a run is active (the normal play state). gBattleMoves_Mainline sits 22112 bytes earlier and holds vanilla-balance stats for the same moves; found and disambiguated the same way as speciesRevisedProfile, using Cut's rebalance (50/Normal/95 -> 60/Grass/100) as the distinguishing anchor since most moves are identical between the two tables.

speciesRevisedProfile.note: gRoguePokemonProfiles_Revised. Rogue's 'Revision Mode' rebalance table -- most fields are sentinel values meaning 'no override, use the normal species table': type1/type2 read 0xFF (TYPE_NONE) and ability1/ability2/hiddenAbility read 0 (ABILITY_NONE) when a species is not rebalanced. Found by fingerprinting known ability triples (Rampardos: Mold Breaker/Rock Head/Sheer Force; Raboot: Blaze/Receiver/Libero) from the game's own generated source against a live memory dump, then disambiguating two structurally-identical candidates by checking that Togepi (which the source lists with no override) reads all-sentinel at only one of them.
